Players Committee card image of [[Bail Organa]] (original printing), game text: “Agenda: rebellion. While in a senate majority (or Stolen Data Tapes on table), your Force drains at battlegrounds with your Alderaanian of ability < 4 are +1. While aboard a corvette, adds one battle destiny and it may not be targeted by weapons.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/bailorgana.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
